title: The Convergence
description: Everything hits at once. Tyvaren, parliament, the Krone, your family — every crisis you have managed or deferred or suppressed is knocking on the same door at the same time.

title: Budget Allocation — Final Quarter Framework
description: The final quarter of the year is approaching. Whatever survives this convergence needs a fiscal framework to operate within. Set the priorities now — while you still have the authority to set them.

title: The War Path — Act 4 Preparation
description: If Tyvaren is the dominant crisis: the war footing needs formal authorization. Brenner and Dusek need to know whether they're planning a defensive campaign or an offensive one.

title: The Exile Path — Contingency Planning
description: If the coup succeeded or the government is collapsing: loyalists are preparing contingency plans. Passports, safe houses, external assets. The question is whether preparing to flee makes fleeing more likely.

title: The Reform Path — Legislative Agenda
description: If the constitution survived: the reform implementation requires a legislative sprint. Enabling acts, judicial appointments, institutional restructuring. Theron has the list. It's longer than the time remaining.

title: The Family — A Decision
description: Whatever was said in the reckoning, it wasn't the end. The family is still here — or still leaving. This is the moment where you decide whether they're your first priority or your last.
